mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_daily_records (user_id, activity_date, steps, estimated_calories, reference_weight, source, estimation_version, source_timestamp, synced_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{activityDate}, #{steps}, #{estimatedCalories}, #{referenceWeight}, #{source}, #{estimationVersion}, #{sourceTimestamp}, NOW(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE steps = VALUES(steps), estimated_calories = VALUES(estimated_calories), reference_weight = VALUES(reference_weight), estimation_version = VALUES(estimation_version), source_timestamp = VALUES(source_timestamp), synced_at = NOW(6)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, activity_date, steps, estimated_calories, reference_weight, source, estimation_version, source_timestamp, synced_at FROM activity_daily_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND source = 'WECHAT_WERUN' AND activity_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY activity_date ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM activity_daily_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND source = #{source}
